He then rode a bike for as much time as he took to walk one round. He covered a total of 15 rounds in cycling and in the first 4 hours of walking. He covered a total of 17 rounds in riding his bike and in 5 hours of walking. If the speeds of his cycle and his bike were in the ratio 3 : 4, find the speed of his cycle. (in km/hr)

Every day, Hari drives his motorcycle at a certain speed and reaches his office exactly on time. One day, after travelling a certain distance, he slowed down to 3/4th of his initial speed and arrived at his office 6 minutes late. Had he slowed down to 2/3rd of his initial speed 6 km further on, he would still have reached 6 minutes late.What is his initial speed (in km/hr)? _____

Two steam-boats Viraat and Samudra start from a jetty on a river and take the same route. Viraat travels down-stream at 10 m/s and Samudra starts 5 minutes later at 5 m/s downstream. passengers stayed on the raft. (in mins)

If flight A travels at 600 km/hr and flight B travels at 400 km/hr, find the distance between city X and city Y (in km).

The ratio of the speeds of Hercules and Hero is 3 : 2.What is the distance between Hero and Hercules, when Champ was equidistant from Hero and Hercules?
